sentences.text: VERSUS  THE STATE OF BIHAR & ANR. RESPONDE

(IA No. 99959/2023-EXEMPTION FROM FILING O.T.)
 Date : 17-05-2023 These matters were called on for hearing today.
CORAM : HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE K.M. JOSEPH

For Petitioner(s) Mrs. Nivedita Nirvikar, Sr. Adv.
 Mr. Pratap Shanker, Adv.
 Mr. Abhinav Ramkrishna, Adv.
 Mr. Swetank Shantanu, AOR  For Respondent(s)
 UPON hearing the counsel the Court made the following  O R D E R Issue notice, returnable in second week of July, 2023.

In the meantime, there shall be no coercive steps against the petitioner in connection with Mahila P.S. Case No.101/2021 at Patna, Bihar for the offence under Sections 341, 342, 323, 498A, 506, 34 of Indian Penal Code, 1860 and Sections 3 and 4 of Dowry Prohibition Act, and Section 3(i)(s) of SC/ST Act.

(JAGDISH KUMAR) (RENU KAPOOR)
